verdict: NOT APPROVED. Hebrew/English correspondence is sound in the actual XML. Weekday Essa has 44 HE / 44 EN strophes and Shabbat Anusah has 46 HE / 46 EN, all complete, continuous and correctly paired. Both Bible sequences have the right verses, scopes, intros and order, including the Zech 9:15 verse-part. Page breaks inside the text fall where the source breaks and don't move any milestones. The Areshet Shofarot/Zikhronot variants are selected locally and correctly. Two blocking defects remain: (B1) the Hebrew spine puts the Shabbat-column pb 137 outside its conditional with ed='1965', which duplicates page 137 out of order in weekday compiles and differs from the English; (B2) the printed English rubric 'On Sabbath.' is silently missing from the English Shabbat alternative. Approval also needs the guideline reading finished and the excluded ken_tagen/calls/hayom/shared-prayer files reviewed.
